verdict.rationale: Mollie is API-first, so it runs headlessly by design. The Payments, Subscriptions, Balances and other REST APIs are driven by scoped API keys or advanced access tokens. Test mode is isolated and can be switched per request via the test key or the `testmode` parameter, which suits CI runs, and Idempotency-Key headers make automated retries safe. Missing for 10: an official CLI, explicit CI/pipeline guidance, fully programmatic test-payment completion (the test checkout and `changePaymentState` flow implies a browser step), a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
